title: lichen-node test failure: three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent — root route table missing leaf route after DAO applied
description: cargo test -p lichen-node on main@7404ccf455: 366 passed, 1 failed — rpl_stack::tests::three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent panics at lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:1876: assert_eq!(root.rpl_node().router.lookup_route(Ipv6Addr::from(leaf_addr)), Some([relay_addr, leaf_addr].as_slice())) — left: None.
